old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a sparkler being ignited. Initially, a hand holds a matchstick, which is then used to light the sparkler. As the sparkler ignites, it begins to emit bright sparks and smoke. The sparks are vivid and dynamic, scattering in various directions, creating a mesmerizing display against the blurred background. The smoke rises steadily from the base of the sparkler, adding a sense of movement and depth to the scene. The background remains out of focus throughout the video, ensuring that the viewer's attention stays on the sparkler and its vibrant activity. The overall atmosphere is one of excitement and celebration, as the sparkler's bright sparks and smoke create a captivating visual experience.

caption: The video captures a close-up, shallow-focus view of a lit sparkler held upright in the right-center of the frame. Its tip burns as a white-hot point, with a reddish coiled wire above it and a thin stick below. Bright sparks emit radially from the glow, their direction and length shifting frame to frame. The blackened coil above the glow lengthens from a short stub into a taller squiggly line as the excerpt progresses. Thin wisps of smoke grow more prominent, drifting upward and left of the burning tip. The blurred background stays fixed, showing a dark vertical post, a bright circular bokeh on the left, and a pale wall with a horizontal seam on the right. The sparkler remains essentially steady throughout, with only minor handheld-level variation.
